text: Four bunks, and a card over each one giving the rate.
Somebody has crossed out every rate and written
FREE THIS SEASON. Nobody has crossed that out.
The third bunk is slept in and the other three are not.
Whoever has it has been here long enough to have
a shelf, a mug, and a very settled opinion of the tide.
Two settles with a rug laid between them, close enough
that strangers end up talking whether they meant to
or not. The keeper arranged it that way on purpose.
A shelf of things left behind: a boot, a spare strap,
three keys to nothing. The keeper will not throw any
of it out in case the owner comes back through.
